title: This Squirrel's Body Drops Below Freezing and Survives

scenes.text: This animal's body drops below freezing, and it lives.
It's the Arctic ground squirrel, from Alaska and northwest Canada.
In winter, it hibernates for up to nine months.
Scientists measured a body temperature of twenty-six degrees Fahrenheit.
Its body fluids stay liquid below freezing. That's called supercooling.
Every few weeks it warms up, or it would die. A body below freezing, still alive.

description:
The Arctic ground squirrel is the only warm-blooded animal known to survive body temperatures below freezing, as low as 26 degrees Fahrenheit.
It hibernates for up to nine months.
Would you survive that?
first_comment: Which animal would you pick to survive the Arctic?
